items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: Mr. Johnson had offered me a vice presidency.

ctx.x: Yeah, a little guy from New Orleans makes it.

Little guy from New Orleans. Makes it. Now, I had my enemies up there. They had some blacks that was in New York. They just didn't like the idea of a southerner coming up there, taking a job with a position that I had. And see, after working there for around about five or six years, Mr. Johnson had offered me a vice presidency. But I couldn't take it because my children were growing up at the time.
